title: SC-MCMP stratified (two-layer) Poiseuille flow vs closed-form two-layer solution

model.walls: post-streaming bounce-back on rows 0 and ny-1 (effective wall planes at the wall-cell centres)

physics.case: two immiscible components in a plane channel, component 1 filling the lower half and component 2 the upper half, driven by a uniform body force per unit mixture volume
physics.reference: cases/mcmp_stratified_poiseuille/analytic.py::layered_poiseuille (velocity + shear-stress continuity at the interface, no-slip at the wall planes, u'' = -G/nu per layer)

reference_viscosity_rules.component: nu_layer = nu of the component occupying that layer (the QR-audit convention)
reference_viscosity_rules.mixture: nu_layer = rho_1 nu_1 + rho_2 nu_2 (continuum limit of the co-moving two-component BGK model; primary)

acceptance_cells.role: hold-out (resolution not used to select the configuration; 45k steps, steady gate not yet reached)

metrics.primary: err_Q_mix = (Q_mix - Q_ref) / Q_ref,  Q_mix = sum_y u_mix(y), u_mix = (rho_1 u_1 + rho_2 u_2)/(rho_1 + rho_2)
secondary: err_Q_mix_lower / err_Q_mix_upper (per-layer split, cut at y = half)
err_interface_rel = (y_int - half)/half with y_int the alpha = 0.5 crossing
gates: phi_contrast > 0.5 (the run must actually be stratified, otherwise it is not a two-phase measurement)
steady = true (relative change of Q_total over the last three samples < 1e-3)

thresholds.note: err_Q_mix is the acceptance gate at 10% and must hold in the repair configuration at ny=25, 33 and the ny=49 hold-out, against BOTH viscosity rules and under the measured (half-way) wall convention; the spurious-current ratio is recorded as an improvement metric only (the model still fails it)

stopping_rule: run the whole matrix once; no threshold may be relaxed afterwards and no unfavourable cell may be dropped
known_limitations: linear pseudopotential only; the coupling must be strong enough (|G_12| >= ~2) to hold a stratified state, otherwise the two components mix and any per-component flux comparison is meaningless
per-component flow rate Q_sigma = sum_y u_sigma is ill-conditioned for a trace component (the velocity shift scales as 1/rho_sigma); Q_mix is the conserved quantity
dry walls (psi_wall = 0) draw the heavy component to the lower wall, moving the interface 0.4-0.5 cells below y = half
float32 CPU runs; differences below 1e-6 carry no physical meaning
reciprocal_reference_note: the no-slip plane is decided by the wall-calibration control (mode=walls, same collision/streaming/bounce-back path): it is half-way, H = ny-2, u_max error 0.03-0.21% at ny=25/33/49, while H = ny-1 is 4.2-8.4% low. The reference below therefore uses H = ny-2 with the interface at the volume-conserving h = half-0.5.

stages.purpose: measure the as-is model and the Guo force term at the segregating coupling (predeclared in docs/MCMP_STRATIFIED_POISEUILLE_SPEC.md)
stages.cells: u_eq=self x force_scheme in {shift,guo} x ny in {25,33,49} x G_12 in {-2.5,-1.0}

stages.purpose: repair search: velocity coupling x force scheme (run after stage 1, disclosed in the report, used only to select the acceptance configuration)
stages.cells: u_eq in {self,mixture,viscous} x force_scheme in {shift,guo} x ny in {25,33}

stages.purpose: hold-out validation of the selected configuration on a resolution that took no part in the selection
stages.cells: u_eq=viscous, force_scheme=guo at (a) ny=33 with tau_upper=0.8 (viscosity contrast 1.33) and (b) ny=49 (queued on the cluster)
